2. Add it to Claude Desktop

Download the {{SHORT}} extension

steps: Paste the line above into Terminal.
Download it, double-click, click Install. No settings to edit.
Try “Ask my {{SHORT}} what it can do.”
agent_html:
Claude Desktop can't run an installer itself, so this page is for the person. If you are an AI agent that can run shell commands, help them like this, asking before each step:

1. Install {{SHORT}}

{{INSTALL_U}}

Windows (PowerShell): {{INSTALL_W}}. Skip this if {{CHECK}} already answers.

2. Install the extension

Download the .mcpb bundle and open it (open file.mcpb on macOS). Claude Desktop shows an install dialog; the user clicks Install.

3. Confirm

In Claude Desktop, Settings → Extensions shows it enabled. Ask Claude: “Ask my {{SHORT}} what it can do.”
